content: निशा [नितरां श्यति तनूकरोति व्यापारान् शो-क <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Night या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी <ls>Bg. 2. 69</ls>. .²2 Turmeric. .²3 A dream. .²4 A collective name for the zodiacal signs Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius, and Capricorn. .²5 A species of plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कचरा</ns> or <ns>उपळसरी</ns>).
